name: SFS Fabrication
old_description: Specialty Fabrication Services is a family owned and operated full-service metal fabrication shop built upon the aptitude of motivated people who believe that teamwork and continuous improvement is essential to providing quality products and services for our valued customers.
about:
Specialty Fabrication Services, operating as SFS Fabrication, is a family-owned and operated metal fabrication shop based in Taylor, Michigan. The company does not disclose a founding year, but notes more than 40 years of combined experience among its staff. It began as a full-service shop built on teamwork and continuous improvement.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication across tubular and sheet metal work, including welding (TIG, MIG, soldering), metal shearing (up to 1/4" x 4ft and 3/16" x 10ft), press brake forming (24 gauge to 1 inch), roll cones (1.5" to 20" OD), tube forming, custom exhaust, sheet metal stamping, laser cutting, waterjet cutting, machining, and finishing services such as painting, powder coating, bead blasting, plating, annealing, and hardening. Equipment includes a 10-foot press brake, 10-foot hydraulic shear, 200-ton hydraulic four-post press, Huth tube expander and bender, Bridgeport mills, lathes, bandsaws, and cold saws. The facility handles projects from prototype development through production runs.

SFS serves industrial, manufacturing, medical, food processing, residential/commercial, automotive, and crematorium sectors. Typical projects include production brackets, riser assemblies, catalyst adapters, food-grade conveyors, catwalks, machine guards, frames, and custom fixturing. The shop works with stainless steel, aluminum, titanium, mild steel, and cast iron.

The company emphasizes integrity, ethical practices, responsiveness, and fair pricing, aiming to build long-term partnerships. It welcomes walk-in customers for estimates and stresses on-time, on-budget delivery.
